data.name: Vedant
data.gender_notes: Vedant is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: The end of the Vedas; Vedanta philosophy
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit veda, 'knowledge', + anta, 'end' — 'the end of the Vedas'. Its root is Sanskrit veda + anta. Vedanta, one of the six schools of Hindu philosophy. Vedant is a Sanskrit name meaning “The end of the Vedas; Vedanta philosophy”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Vedant expresses “The end of the Vedas; Vedanta philosophy”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit veda, 'knowledge', + anta, 'end' — 'the end of the Vedas'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vedant total 21, reducing to 3. Number 3 is associated with expression, creativity and optimism.

faq.q: From which word is Vedant derived?
faq.a: From the Sanskrit veda, 'knowledge', + anta, 'end' — 'the end of the Vedas'.

faq.q: Is Vedant mentioned in scripture or history?
faq.a: Vedanta, one of the six schools of Hindu philosophy.

faq.q: What is the historical or scriptural reference for Vedant?
faq.a: Vedanta, one of the six schools of Hindu philosophy.

faq.q: What is the lucky number for Vedant?
faq.a: The Pythagorean lucky number for Vedant is 3 (ruling planet Jupiter). This is an interpretive association, not a factual claim.

faq.q: Which day is associated with Vedant?
faq.a: Thursday is the traditional association for Vedant. This is interpretive.

faq.q: Which gemstone is associated with Vedant?

faq.q: Which colours are associated with Vedant?
faq.a: Yellow, Gold are the traditional associations for Vedant. These are interpretive.

faq.q: What is the numerology of Vedant?
faq.a: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vedant total 21, reducing to 3. Number 3 is associated with expression, creativity and optimism.

faq.q: How reliable is the meaning given for Vedant?
faq.a: The meaning of Vedant carries confidence HIGH in this record. It is established by classical lexicography or scripture.

faq.q: Does Vedant have a religious meaning?
faq.a: Vedant is recorded as a hindu name meaning “The end of the Vedas; Vedanta philosophy”.

faq.q: What is the English meaning of Vedant?
faq.a: In English, Vedant is rendered as “The end of the Vedas; Vedanta philosophy”.

faq.q: Is Vedant suitable for a baby?
faq.a: Vedant is used as a male given name; suitability is a personal choice.
